section_summary.extract_value: This general discussion section synthesizes findings from two studies examining the role of guilt in linking appearance goals for exercise to body image outcomes in female undergraduate students in the UK. Study 1 provides cross-sectional evidence for the association between appearance goals, introjected regulation (guilt), and body image, while Study 2 provides experimental support for the causal pathway through guilt-based motivation. The authors propose that interventions targeting guilt-based exercise motivation could mitigate negative effects of appearance goals on body image.
